_meta.usage: 1996–2010 plates (Russian-style: A 1234 or AB 1234, then a box at the right with the two-digit code over RT, no flag): type only the two digits in that box
_meta.note: Codes of the 1996 format: 01 Dushanbe and the Districts of Republican Subordination, 02 Sughd, 03 Khatlon, 04 Gorno-Badakhshan. These plates are on old cars and point to the region of registration at the time.
_meta.miss_note: not a 1996–2010 Tajik code: a current plate (flag and TJ at the left; use `--kind plate`), or a Russian plate (RUS and the Russian flag in the box at the right)

01.note: 01 covered Dushanbe and the Districts of Republican Subordination until 2010
